# Tests known to fail on Windows. Each line names the child of epic
# links-windows-qr8l that owns the failure. nightly.yml's `windows` job skips
# exactly these, so a Windows-only failure in any other test turns the lane
# red. The ticket that fixes a failure deletes its lines, and the epic is done
# when no lines remain.
#
# <ticket> <package> <top-level test, or * for a package whose tests do not
# compile on Windows>

nightly-windows-failure internal/cli TestAnUnreadableUpstreamFailsOnlyTheSelectionThatReadsIt

nightly-windows-failure internal/cli TestUnreadableWorkingDirFailsOnlyARelativePath

nightly-windows-failure internal/dbsnapshot TestList_RefusesFileAtSnapshotsDir
nightly-windows-failure internal/environ TestConstructorsGiveAChildItsDirectoryAsPWD

nightly-windows-failure internal/store TestUnnamedHolderDoesNotGuessPastAFailedRead
nightly-windows-failure internal/store TestUnreadableHolderDirIsReportedNotSwallowed
